Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“The deep remembers everything. You’re how it talks about it.”

Echo-Diver (Abyssal). You tune to the deep register. Where other Echo-Divers hear a half-second ahead, you hear a half-second behind — the settled time, the truth after everyone agrees what happened.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Echo-Diver).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Deep-Current Resistance. You resist psychic damage.
  • Tide Recall (retrocognition). 1/Soma Break, touch a surface, creature, or object. The GM tells you one true thing from its recent past. Window: 24h at Tier 1, 1 week at Tier 2, 1 year at Tier 3, any time at Tier 4.
  • Still Water. Reroll the lowest die on Insight checks, and on checks to resist the shaken condition.
  • Signature. You gain Tide Recall at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.hint: Gain the Echo-Diver (Abyssal) signature feat: Tide Recall.
